title: INTERPRETABLE EMBEDDINGS WITH SPARSE AUTOENCODERS: A DATA ANALYSIS TOOLKIT
benchmark_measurement: Co-occurrence of offensive language with religious concepts (e.g., 'mentions religion', 'mentions atheism') in text data, as identified by correlations between sparse autoencoder (SAE) latents.
findings: Using Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) embeddings on the CivilComments dataset, the study found evidence of bias, discovering that 'offensive language' latents frequently co-occur with latents associated with mentions of both religion and atheism.
